newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: India tenders to sell 28,000/T, Aug 3-5 HAN.
newsitem.headline: India tenders to sell 28,000/T, Aug 3-5 HAN.

text.p: State-owned Indian Oil Corp (IOC) has issued a tender to sell a 28,000 tonnes of high aromatic naphtha (HAN) for August 3-5 lifting from Bombay on the west coast of India, industry sources said on Thursday.
The tender closes July 24 and is valid for one day.

In its last tender, IOC awarded to Swiss trader, Glencore a 27,000 tonnes HAN cargo at $32.80 per tonne discount to spot US Gulf 87 octane gasoline qutoes on a free on board Madras July 24-26 lifting.
